Sun Data Analytics builds recurring reporting systems that turn raw data into readable reports, dashboards, tables, charts, and interpretation-ready summaries.

## Overview

Automated reporting systems are useful when the same kinds of questions come up repeatedly. Instead of rebuilding reports by hand, the workflow can collect source data, refresh cleaned tables, generate charts and tables, and produce a readable report structure that is easier to review.

Client data and private reports remain confidential. Public descriptions can still explain the reporting structure, methods, and kinds of questions answered.

:::: {.index-list}
::: {.index-item}
### Creator Performance Reports

### Audience and Revenue Reports

Audience demographics reports, revenue and monetization reports, subscriber trends, and performance summaries over time.
:::

::: {.index-item}
### Publishing and Content Strategy Reports

Publishing schedule reports, content type comparison reports, topic and tag performance reports, and title classification reports.
:::

::: {.index-item}
### Text and Conversation Reports

Transcript or chat analysis reports that connect coded text, summaries, or qualitative signals with broader reporting questions.
:::

::: {.index-item}
### Monthly or Recurring Decision Reports

Regular decision reports that gather the same core metrics, charts, tables, and interpretation notes into a consistent format.
:::
::::
